description: This file contains unit tests for the Patient class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing patient object creation, identifier management, and related behaviors. It does not interact with the database and focuses on class method correctness.

classes.name: PatientTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for verifying the behavior of the Patient class in OpenMRS.

methods.name: patient_shouldConstructCloneWhenPassedPatient
methods.description: Tests whether the copy constructor of Patient creates a correct clone, including identifiers, names, allergy status, and relationships.

methods.name: addIdentifier_shouldAddIdentifierToCurrentList
methods.description: Verifies that the addIdentifier method adds new identifiers correctly, preventing duplicates, and handling re-adding voided identifiers.

methods.name: addIdentifier_shouldNotFailWithNullIdentifiersList
methods.description: Ensures that adding an identifier to a Patient with a null identifiers list does not cause failure.

methods.name: getIdentifiers_shouldNotReturnNull
methods.description: Checks that getIdentifiers returns a non-null list even if none are set.

methods.name: removeIdentifier_shouldRemoveIdentifierIfExists
methods.description: Tests that identifiers are correctly removed from the Patient's identifiers collection.

methods.name: removeIdentifier_shouldTestIdentifierCollectionChanged
methods.description: Tests complex identifier collection behaviors, including ordering, voiding, and re-adding identifiers based on date created and voided status.

methods.name: getActiveIdentifiers_shouldReturnPreferredIdentifiersFirstInTheList
methods.description: Validates that getActiveIdentifiers returns identifiers ordered with preferred identifiers first, followed by non-preferred, excluding voided ones.
